name: Permit Radar
pitch: Weekly Detroit-area building-permit lead lists for trades (roofers, electricians, HVAC, plumbers, dumpster rental), ~$30/month. Sources: data.detroitmi.gov permits; check Royal Oak and Oakland County. Address, permit details and contractor of record only; no homeowner enrichment.

name: Storm Lead
pitch: Morning-after alerts for Michigan roofing/restoration contractors listing ZIPs hit by hail 1in+ or damaging wind, $50-100/month. Sources: NOAA SPC storm reports, NWS alerts, OpenFEMA. G0 includes a 24-month Michigan backtest of alert frequency.

name: Great Lakes Conditions
pitch: One auto-updating page per Michigan lake, harbor and launch (waves, wind, water temp, water level, advisories). Launch target April 1, 2027. Sources: NOAA NDBC, GLERL/GLOS, NWS marine forecasts, NOAA CO-OPS, Open-Meteo.

name: Recall Checks for Used-Car Dealers
pitch: Open-recall checks on dealer inventory via NHTSA vPIC + recalls API.

name: Contract-Winner Intel (BidRadar add-on)
pitch: Who won what, as a BidRadar add-on. Source: USAspending API.

name: Benchmarking Compliance Backend
pitch: ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager web services; access requires approval, so draft the request for Nick.

name: Weather-Trigger Job Alerts
pitch: Alerts for roofers, landscapers and venues from the NWS API. May merge with Storm Lead.

name: Site-Selection Reports
pitch: Reports for new shop owners from the Census API.

name: Satellite Change Alerts
pitch: Change alerts for land owners and farmers from Copernicus Sentinel-2.

name: Filing Alerts (SEC EDGAR)
pitch: Niche filing alerts, e.g. Michigan companies' 8-Ks.

name: Supplier News Monitor
pitch: Supplier news monitor from GDELT.

name: Energy Cost by Area Pages
pitch: EIA API pages.

name: River Levels for Paddlers
pitch: USGS Water Services. May merge with Great Lakes Conditions.

name: Air-Quality Alerts for Schools and Youth Sports
pitch: AirNow.

name: Food and Drug Recall Alerts
pitch: openFDA alerts for restaurants, daycares, pharmacies.

name: Rare-Bird Alerts
pitch: eBird API. Check terms first; likely KILL for commercial use.

name: EV Road-Trip Planner
pitch: NREL Alt Fuel Stations. Crowded market.

name: Next-Bus Lobby Displays
pitch: GTFS / GTFS-Realtime displays for coffee shops and apartments.

name: Michigan Spirits Price Watch
pitch: monthly "what's changing" digest plus a POS-ready price file for party stores and bars, and one public page per bottle ("Tito's 1.75L price Michigan"). Idea Scout 2026-10-25, 21/25. Source(s): MLCC Spirits Price Book (fixed-width TXT, monthly, no key; no license stated, state public record, confirm with MLCC before charging).

name: Michigan Site Contamination Check
pitch: enter an address, get a $29-49 PDF listing Part 201 contamination sites, leaking USTs, brownfields and land-use restrictions within 1/8 and 1/4 mile, for commercial realtors, small buyers and community lenders before they pay for a Phase I. Idea Scout 2026-11-01, 19/25. Source(s): EGLE RRD Open Data ArcGIS REST (no key; FAQ says no use restrictions, confirm on gis-egle terms page; drop the project-manager name field).

name: Recall Check for Kids' Resale Shops
pitch: intake checker plus a weekly "pull these items" alert for strollers, cribs, car seats and toys sold by consignment shops. Idea Scout 2026-10-25, 19/25. Source(s): CPSC Recalls API (REST/JSON, no key, federal data).

name: New Liquor License Leads MI
pitch: weekly list of newly licensed bars, restaurants and party stores by county, sold to POS/payment reps, beverage distributors, liquor-liability insurers, linen and pest vendors; doubles as the customer list for Spirits Price Watch. Idea Scout 2026-10-25, 18/25. Source(s): MLCC Listing of Active, Conditional and Escrowed Licenses (weekly XLSX, no key; business name, address and license type only).

name: Michigan Road Construction Pages
pitch: one page per corridor and county ("I-696 construction 2027") listing planned MDOT projects, plus an add-on for fleets and businesses on affected roads. Idea Scout 2026-10-25, 16/25. Source(s): MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program (ArcGIS REST, CSV, GeoJSON, no key; confirm license and look for the newer program than the 2025-2029 draft).

name: Michigan Section 8 Rent Limits by ZIP
pitch: one page per Michigan ZIP with FY2027 Small Area FMRs by bedroom, change vs FY2026, plus a landlord alert when HUD revises; needs a Michigan angle (MSHDA and Detroit Housing Commission payment standards) to beat the free Fair Market Rent Map. Idea Scout 2026-11-01, 16/25. Source(s): HUD FY2027 Fair Market Rents + HUD User FMR API (free token, 60 calls/min; must show the HUD User non-endorsement notice).
